candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so anyone can call it, causing the owner check to be skipped.
Replace the argument to withdraw with a constant zero, so no funds are actually transferred to the owner.
Delete the entire body of withdrawAll so it does nothing, preserving the onlyOwner modifier and signature.
Change the require condition in onlyOwner to always pass by replacing it with 'true', allowing any caller to pass the modifier.
Delete the require statement inside the onlyOwner modifier so it performs no access control.
Changed transfer target from msg.sender to owner to make withdraw send funds to a different address.
Removed the actual transfer call so withdraw does not reduce the contract balance, causing withdraw() to differ.
Replaced transfer with a call that sends zero value, so withdraw does not move funds.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier requirement by making the modifier body empty, allowing anyone to call withdraw.
Remove the revert on failed call so sendMoney always succeeds even when the external call fails.
Replace _target.call{value: _value}(_data) with _target.delegatecall(_data) so no value is transferred.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney so anyone can call it.
